Dorsal Capital Management LLC Boosted Its Tiffany & Co New (TIF) Stake by $41.60 Million Posted by Michael Collier 36 pm
Dorsal Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Tiffany & Co New (TIF) by 59.09% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dorsal Capital Management Llc bought 325,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 31.54% with the market. The hedge fund held 875,000 shares of the consumer specialties company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $112.85 million, up from 550,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dorsal Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Tiffany & Co New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $10.04B market cap company. The stock increased 3.51% or $2.79 during the last trading session, reaching $82.38. About 1.85M shares traded. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has declined 10.90% since January 7, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 10.90% the S&P500.
Dorsal Capital Management Llc, which manages about $1.15B and $1.73 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (NASDAQ:FB) by 125,000 shares to 500,000 shares, valued at $82.23M in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Pandora Media Inc (NYSE:P) by 2.75M shares in the quarter, leaving it with 4.75 million shares, and cut its stake in Microsoft Corp (NASDAQ:MSFT).
